native_behavior: Strict TypeBox unknown-property rejection occurs before execute and tool_result extension hooks; fixed core diagnostic may echo model-supplied arguments. Extension cannot replace that with enum without weakening schema or native change.
required_preserved: Exact6strict tool schemas, unknown fields rejected
No host process/bridge call on pre-execute rejection
Extension/bridge/runtime errors contain safe enums only, never raw host/CSV/stdout/errors
scope_qualification: Native validation diagnostics can echo already model-origin arguments and static schema text; not a leak of previously hidden host/target bytes. Must separately measure/cap generated argument/diagnostic length through fixed provider output allowance; response byte cap not proven until that chain is measured.
